# Agent Setup Pill

## Summary
A small floating pill that hands setup off to the user's AI coding agent in one click. The label names the outcome ("Onboard your agent to Acme"), a row of agent marks shows which tools it works with, a tooltip says what the click will do, and clicking copies a ready-made setup prompt to the clipboard. A separate round button dismisses it.

## When to use
- Docs sites, dashboards and quickstarts where many users will set the product up through Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar instead of by hand.
- As a lightweight, always-reachable entry point that sits alongside the regular docs — not instead of them.
- When the setup can be described as one self-contained prompt (install, configure, verify).

## When not to use
- Inside a guided onboarding step that needs to wait for a first event — use the Prompt Onboarding card, which shows the prompt and tracks status.
- When the setup needs account-specific secrets the page can't safely put in a prompt on a public page.
- As a general "Ask AI" entry point — this pill only copies a setup prompt; it doesn't open a chat.

## Anatomy
- Pill button: outcome label + a row of 3–5 agent marks.
- Tooltip above the pill: one line describing the action ("Copies a setup prompt for your AI coding tool").
- Copied state: the label swaps to a check and a short instruction; the marks collapse.
- Dismiss button: a separate circular button with an ×, visually detached from the pill so it can't be hit by accident.

## Behavior
- Enters with a short rise-and-fade once the page settles; agent marks stagger in after the label.
- Hover or keyboard focus shows the tooltip; Escape, blur and pointer leave hide it. The tooltip never appears in the copied state.
- On hover, the agent marks fan out slightly as an affordance that the pill is clickable.
- Click copies the prompt. The label rolls to "Prompt copied — paste it into your agent" with a check for ~2s, then returns. The pill resizes smoothly between the two widths.
- If the clipboard API is blocked, still confirm, and make sure the prompt is reachable elsewhere (e.g. a docs page) so the user isn't stuck.
- Dismiss hides the pill with a short exit animation and should persist (per user or per browser) — don't bring it back on the next page view.

## Content guidelines
- Label: outcome-first and product-specific — "Onboard your agent to Acme", "Set up Acme with your agent". Not "Copy prompt".
- Tooltip: one sentence, says exactly what happens — the click copies, it doesn't open anything.
- Prompt: imperative, numbered steps, an explicit definition of done, keep secrets in env vars, and ask the agent to summarize its changes.
- Agent marks: only tools the prompt has actually been tested with; keep the brand marks small and monochrome except where the brand colour is the mark.

## Accessibility
- The pill is a real `<button>`; its accessible name is the visible label. The agent marks are `aria-hidden` decoration (each still has a `title` for sighted pointer users).
- The tooltip uses `role="tooltip"` and is linked with `aria-describedby` while visible; it opens on focus as well as hover.
- The copied confirmation is announced through an `aria-live="polite"` region.
- The dismiss button has `aria-label="Dismiss"` and a 40px hit target.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop the rise, roll and fan-out; keep plain fades.

## Related patterns
- Prompt Onboarding — the full-card version with prompt preview, snippet fallback and first-event status.
- Setup Checklist — where a dismissed pill's step can live on.
- Shiny Button — another single, attention-drawing call to action; don't use both on one screen.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface SetupAgent {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** A small mark (~16px). Brand marks read best as monochrome or their own colours. */
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}

export interface AgentSetupPillProps {
  /** Outcome-first label, e.g. "Onboard your agent to Acme". */
  label: string;
  /** Says what the click does before it happens. */
  tooltip?: string;
  /** The setup prompt copied to the clipboard. */
  prompt: string;
  /** The coding agents the prompt works in, shown as a row of marks. */
  agents: SetupAgent[];
  /** Shown in place of the label for a moment after copying. */
  copiedLabel?: string;
  onCopy?: () => void;
  /** Omit to hide the dismiss button. */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const spring = { type: "spring", stiffness: 420, damping: 32 } as const;

export function AgentSetupPill({
  label,
  tooltip = "Copies a setup prompt for your AI coding tool",
  prompt,
  agents,
  copiedLabel = "Prompt copied — paste it into your agent",
  onCopy,
  onDismiss,
  className,
}: AgentSetupPillProps) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const tooltipId = React.useId();
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);
  const [hint, setHint] = React.useState(false);
  const timer = React.useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);

  React.useEffect(() => () => clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(prompt);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard can be blocked (insecure context, iframe); still confirm.
    }
    setCopied(true);
    setHint(false);
    onCopy?.();
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2200);
  }

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 12, scale: 0.96 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.96 }}
      transition={spring}
      className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", className)}
    >
      <div className="relative">
        <AnimatePresence>
          {hint && !copied && (
            <motion.div
              id={tooltipId}
              role="tooltip"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
              className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-full left-1/2 mb-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-lg border bg-popover px-3 py-1.5 text-xs whitespace-nowrap text-popover-foreground shadow-sm"
            >
              {tooltip}
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={copy}
          onPointerEnter={() => setHint(true)}
          onPointerLeave={() => setHint(false)}
          onFocus={() => setHint(true)}
          onBlur={() => setHint(false)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Escape" && setHint(false)}
          aria-describedby={hint ? tooltipId : undefined}
          whileTap={reduce ? undefined : { scale: 0.97 }}
          layout={!reduce}
          transition={spring}
          className="group flex h-10 items-center gap-3 rounded-full border bg-card pr-3 pl-4 text-sm font-medium text-card-foreground shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:outline-none"
        >
          <span className="relative grid overflow-hidden">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout" initial={false}>
              <motion.span
                key={copied ? "copied" : "idle"}
                initial={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                {copied && <Check className="size-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" aria-hidden />}
                {copied ? copiedLabel : label}
              </motion.span>
            </AnimatePresence>
          </span>

          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {!copied && (
              <motion.span
                aria-hidden
                initial={{ opacity: 0, width: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, width: "auto" }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, width: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                className="flex items-center"
              >
                {agents.map((agent, i) => (
                  <motion.span
                    key={agent.id}
                    title={agent.label}
                    initial={reduce ? false : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ ...spring, delay: reduce ? 0 : 0.15 + i * 0.05 }}
                    className="grid size-5 place-items-center transition-[margin,transform] duration-200 not-first:ml-0.5 group-hover:not-first:ml-1.5 group-hover:-translate-y-px [&_svg]:size-4"
                  >
                    {agent.icon}
                  </motion.span>
                ))}
              </motion.span>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </motion.button>

        <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
          {copied ? copiedLabel : ""}
        </span>
      </div>

      {onDismiss && (
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={onDismiss}
          aria-label="Dismiss"
          whileTap={reduce ? undefined : { scale: 0.92 }}
          className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border bg-card text-muted-foreground shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:outline-none"
        >
          <X className="size-4" />
        </motion.button>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```
